title: Flamingo: On Load Balancing in DAG-based Consensus Protocols
summary: Distributed data management systems deployed in untrusted environments rely on Byzantine Fault-Tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols to tolerate malicious failures. DAG-based BFT protocols improve throughput by letting validators disseminate transactions concurrently and by scaling execution across multiple workers.
